title: Molfar Vertep
summary: Experimental local-first roleplay frontend with optional built-in agent; its author reports code-enforced per-character knowledge scopes and beliefs.
documentation_observations: README describes an early, actively changing, local-first roleplay application and its optional AI agent.
Developer reports promising secret-isolation tests with small samples; no independent benchmarking has been performed.
limitations: Documentation reviewed, but no local install or independent performance/privacy test has been run; memory separation and adult-content compatibility require explicit reproduction.
